title: Peak Outpatient and Emergency Department Visit Forecasting for Patients With Chronic Respiratory Diseases Using Machine Learning Methods: Retrospective Cohort Study.
summary: A retrospective cohort included 13,218 visits; random forests achieved the best reported AUC (0.809) in the combined dataset. The retrospective forecast does not establish improved service delivery or transport to other health systems.
ai_technology: Machine-learning models forecasted peak outpatient and emergency department demand for patients with chronic respiratory diseases using visit, weather and pollution features.
